review_type: AI-assisted editorial and computational checks; no independent academic peer review

academic_review.evidence: Completed consistency pass over all ten units, using retained review for unchanged Units 1–7 and new review of Units 8–10. Conventions, support, conditioning, approximation limits and numerical stability checked.

curriculum_coverage.evidence: All selected Stat H-102 topic groups mapped to ten authored units; named distribution families, generators, cumulants, conditional moments and transformations included.

worked_solutions.evidence: Thirty complete questions, exactly three per unit. All saved earlier checks rerun; 216 independent numerical checks passed using enumeration, integration, SciPy and exact rational/matrix arithmetic.

originality.evidence: Originally authored educational prose and synthetic questions; source formulas checked without reproducing source prose. No exact repeated long paragraphs; no exhaustive external plagiarism scan claimed.

simulation_behavior.evidence: Ten explorers passed 321 independent fixture cases, 2,500 numerical comparisons and 134 DOM interaction checks. Invalid values, reset, zero evidence and conditional rows, deterministic boundaries, model limitations checked.

static_pages.evidence: Ten crawlable chapters preserve every serialized source section, question and solution; 58 pre-existing books retain content. Navigation, local references, explorer slots and canonical/sitemap consistency checked. Every delimited source formula also survives HTML parsing, including comparisons and matrix ampersands.

seo_metadata.evidence: All ten new canonical chapter URLs have unique sitemap entries and descriptive titles, metadata and truthful valid JSON-LD; whole-site metadata checker passes 491 URLs.

mobile_reader.evidence: Cloud Chrome preview tested at desktop and 390-pixel iframe widths. Phone content/client widths match at 375 pixels, Bayes table scroll is contained, menu/Escape/navigation/font/solution controls and normal/beta resets work. Formula-rendering defect corrected and verified in real KaTeX annotations.
